answer: A sybil-resistant economy can quarantine newcomers on an island, where each identity must earn entry to the wider market. A newcomer posts a refundable bond and completes checkable work verified by independent reviewers from other communities. Only after several unrelated reviewers confirm honest work does the gate open and the bond return. Hollow shells copying each other fail, since they cannot produce distinct work, and a quill of forged praise from one clique cannot pass a threshold drawn from strangers. Later fraud slashes the bond and exiles the identity, making fakery costly.
